firm_data.firm_description: Miller Law Group combines wide-ranging legal experience with practical, bottom-line business acumen, leveraging their knowledge to create cost-effective, strategic legal solutions that deliver direct financial benefits to their clients’ companies.
notable_facts: The firm is an AV Peer-Rated firm, reflecting its high ethical standards and legal abilities.
The firm has built an extensive, proprietary database of information and resources and an electronic legal library.
technology_signals: Maximizes use of advanced technology and virtual networking to streamline processes and facilitate communication.
Integrates technology into every aspect of its legal practice to improve research, advice, and documentation.
